text.en: Dog owners warmly praise walkers like Jana, Gui, Tiago, and Megan for their punctuality, warmth, and genuine passion for caring for dogs. Reviewers describe a dependable service where walkers arrive like clockwork and treat every dog like part of the family. Clients express deep peace of mind knowing their dogs are supervised by devoted professionals.

Clients report that their dogs love their daily group outings across local parks and marshes, returning home relaxed and ready to snooze. Owners highlight that energetic puppies and city dogs receive excellent mental and physical exercise alongside compatible four-legged friends. Handlers note that dogs wait eagerly by the window for their walker arrival.

Pet parents value the transparent and proactive communication from the team, especially regular photo and video stories shared on social media. Reviewers appreciate being able to check in on their dogs outdoor adventures while at work. Clients describe seamless scheduling and quick responses from the walking team.

q.en: Where do Hound Crew take dogs for their group walks?

a.en: Clients report that dogs enjoy varied outdoor pack walks in local green spaces such as Hackney Marshes.

q.en: Do owners receive photos of their dogs during walks?

a.en: Yes, clients frequently mention seeing photos and adventure updates of their dogs on Instagram throughout the week.

q.en: Does Hound Crew offer pick-up and drop-off?

a.en: Yes, walkers collect dogs directly from owners homes and drop them back safely after their exercise session.
